scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/api --reload-dir apps/api --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.dev:worker: uv run --project apps/api celery --workdir apps/api -A app.worker.celery_app worker --loglevel=INFO
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api/app apps/api/tests apps/api/alembic
scripts.db:upgrade: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:downgrade: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini downgrade -1
scripts.db:revision: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini revision --autogenerate
scripts.db:history: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini history --indicate-current
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:ts-analyzer && npm run build:diagram-renderer
scripts.check:packages: npm run check:ts-analyzer && npm run check:diagram-renderer
scripts.test:workflow: uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests/test_workflow_state.py apps/api/tests/test_workflow_graph.py apps/api/tests/test_workflow_runner.py apps/api/tests/test_checkpointer_contract.py -q
scripts.lint:workflow: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api/app/workflows apps/api/tests/test_workflow_state.py apps/api/tests/test_workflow_graph.py apps/api/tests/test_workflow_runner.py apps/api/tests/test_checkpointer_contract.py apps/api/tests/_checkpointer_worker.py
scripts.check:scaffold: npm run test:api && npm run lint:api && npm run test:web && npm run check:compose
scripts.check:domain-auth: npm run test:api && npm run lint:api
scripts.check:workflow: npm run test:workflow && npm run lint:workflow
scripts.check: npm run check:scaffold && npm run check:packages
